title: OpenTelemetry GenAI — Tracing Tool Calls End-to-End

questions.question: How many spans does the default agent_loop create?
options: 3: one span per city only
6: one span per model and city pair
9 spans
12: a root plus four spans for each city
questions.explanation: The loop creates 1 root invoke_agent span, 2 llm.chat spans, 3 tool.execute spans, and 3 nested mcp.call spans, for 9 total.

questions.question: Which span kind is assigned to fake_mcp_call?
options: INTERNAL with no parent
SERVER with an HTTP listener
PRODUCER with a new trace for every call
CLIENT, nested under the tool span
questions.explanation: MCP is an outbound call from the agent process, so fake_mcp_call starts a CLIENT span as a child of the tool execution span.

questions.question: What traceparent value does fake_mcp_call attach?
options: 00-{trace_id}-{mcp_span_id}-01
The fixed string 00-0000-0000-01
A new random trace unrelated to the parent
Only the parent span id without a version
questions.explanation: The implementation formats W3C trace context with version 00, the shared trace id, the current MCP span id, and flags 01.

questions.question: What is the default content-capture behavior?
options: Prompts and completions are always printed
content events only with OTEL_CAPTURE_CONTENT=1
Capture is enabled when OTEL_CAPTURE_CONTENT is unset
Only tool arguments are captured
questions.explanation: Content capture is opt-in; the default environment leaves the event count at zero, while setting the variable to 1 adds the events.

questions.question: Which attributes are attached by the two simulated call types?
options: LLM spans carry filesystem paths; tools carry only timestamps
Both carry the same model name and no tool identity
LLM response attrs; tool name/call-id attrs
Only the root span receives response metadata
questions.explanation: fake_llm_call records response and token usage fields, while fake_tool_execute identifies the generated tool name and tool call id.

questions.question: What relationship should all nine spans in the default trace have?
options: Each city starts an unrelated trace
Only MCP spans share a trace id
The root has no trace id
They share one trace_id and use parent span ids to form the hierarchy
questions.explanation: start_span propagates the root trace id through its children; parent fields preserve the invoke-agent, LLM, tool, and MCP nesting.
